entities.summary: Gulchohra Huseyn gizi Mammadova is an Azerbaijani architect, academician, Doctor of Architecture, and the current president (rector) of Azerbaijan University of Architecture and Construction. She was also a deputy in the Azerbaijani National Assembly from 2000 to 2005.
